title: A Hundred Paces Through a Willow Leaf

source.book: Records of the Grand Historian, Annals of Zhou
source.quote: In Chu there was a man named Yang Youji, a master archer. A hundred paces from a willow leaf he shot at it, and in a hundred shots he hit it a hundred times.

moral: A hundred hits out of a hundred is not born — it is practised, arrow by arrow.

story.title: A Leaf a Hundred Paces Away
story.text: Yang Youji hung a willow leaf on a tree and stepped back a hundred paces.
story.narration: In the state of Chu there was a man named Yang Youji, a very good archer. He hung a single willow leaf on a tree, stepped back a hundred paces, and drew his bow.

story.title: One Arrow, and Another
story.text: One arrow struck the leaf, and the next struck it too — the crowd cheered.
story.narration: One arrow flew and struck the willow leaf; the next struck it again. Thousands of people were watching, and all of them shouted: what shooting! But it was not inborn — it was practised, arrow by arrow.

keyMoment.question: How does one hit a willow leaf a hundred paces away?

options.text: He was born with better eyes than other people
options.hint: Being born good at it cannot be practised.

options.text: Start at ten paces and practise, arrow by arrow, out to a hundred

options.hint: One arrow can be luck; a hundred cannot.

keyMoment.reveal: From near to far, arrow by arrow — a hundred hits out of a hundred is practised.

misconceptions: Missing means you have no talent

quiz.question: How far away did Yang Youji stand when he shot at the willow leaf?
quiz.explanation: A hundred paces away, at a single willow leaf — that is the whole saying.

quiz.question: Why could he shoot so accurately?
options: He was born with good eyes
quiz.explanation: Near first, then farther, one step at a time — accuracy is practised.

quiz.question: The first time you try skipping rope, you cannot do a single skip. Which thought is right?
options: The rope is bad — get another
I was born unable to skip
Take it slowly; today, just get over one
quiz.explanation: Just like the willow leaf: near to far, few to many, it comes with practice.

levelScript.hint: Aim at the leaf, let go
